corrections.reason: Same error as Beta—confused missing required fields with truncated output. A.5 applies when generation cuts off mid-sentence due to token limits; here the issue is structural non-compliance with required output format.

Missed that this symptom (echoing input format rather than generating content) is a classic sign of ambiguous task specification (B.1) where the agent doesn't understand what output is actually required.

Gamma assigned no codes at all, missing a clear instance of premature hop termination. When a task explicitly requires N retrievals and zero are performed, this is definitionally B.9 - the coordinator failed to complete the required retrieval chain.

Same error as Alpha - focused on what the output lacks rather than why it lacks it. The root cause is that proper instructions never reached the agent (A.7), not that the agent failed to format its output for downstream use (A.8).
Same error as Alpha and Beta - misinterpreted echoing system prompts as an output structure problem rather than recognizing it as task abandonment.
